rationale: Builds on the current staged reverse-tail recurrent baseline instead of restarting. The edit adds a compact late-training anchor-refresh curriculum inside the existing reverse tail recurrence: the decoder-output anchor stays fixed early, then gradually refreshes toward the recurrent hidden state late in training and is evaluated at full strength. This spends no meaningful byte budget, keeps shapes compile-stable, preserves the exact final int8+zlib path, and targets the still-live anchor-variant idea category rather than another scalar sweep.
title: Late Reverse-Tail Anchor EMA
